intent: Individually teach baby/babies with visible original one/two comparison, child/children and agreement, written inclusive teenager age range, required adult accompaniment and an adult, relative versus close friend without assuming unknown kinship, husband/wife viewpoint, wife/wives versus possession and couple/a couple of. Learners produce original forms, changed rewrites and fresh age/count transfer. No independent credit or age/kinship inference from appearance.
picturePurpose: Original one-left/two-right fictional babies support exact singular/plural and count comparison, with labels and regions authored in code. Other ages and family roles are explicit written records and neutral coded paths, not appearance guesses.

workshop.title: 先看人数与关系，再选词形
workshop.instruction: 先判断记录说了谁、几个人，再选词和填句子。把单复数放进自己的例句，最后读新活动记录；不要直接照搬上一题的年龄范围。

items.label: child：children是不规则复数，不再加s
items.prompt: 图书角有三个孩子。要写“三个孩子需要安静的空间”，哪句词形和主谓一致都对？

items.material: Every child needs time to play.
items.reason: child是单数，children是不规则复数，不是childs或childrens。Three children need说三个孩子；本句Every child needs逐个说每个孩子，用单数child和needs。先看数量词，再核对名词与谓语。
items.hint: child→children；Every child needs用单数，three children need用复数。

options.text: Three childs needs a quiet space.
options.reason: child不能变成childs；三个孩子用children，谓语也不加s。

options.text: Three children need a quiet space.

items.label: teenager：年龄范围要看两头
items.prompt: 登记年龄：An12岁、Bo13岁、Chen19岁、Di20岁。按通常13—19岁的范围，哪组都属于teenagers？

wordDecision.prompt: 登记年龄：An12岁、Bo13岁、Chen19岁、Di20岁。按通常13—19岁的范围，哪组都属于teenagers？

items.material: The club welcomes every teenager in town.
items.reason: teenager通常指13到19岁的人，包括两个端点。18、19岁即使已成年，仍可称teenager。按写明的年龄对照范围，不能凭长相或年级猜。本句every后用单数teenager。

options.text: Bo (13) and Chen (19).
options.reason: 通常13到19岁都属于teenager，两个端点也包括在内。

options.text: An (12) and Di (20).
options.reason: 12岁和20岁不在通常13—19岁的teenager范围内，不能因为都很年轻就选。

options.text: Only Bo; a 19-year-old can never be a teenager.
options.reason: 19岁仍可称teenager；是否已成年是另一件事，不能把上限19排除。

items.label: adult：看陪同要求，再核对an
items.prompt: 参观须知写着“Children must visit the cave with an adult.” 哪项忠实转述这句话？

wordDecision.prompt: 参观须知写着“Children must visit the cave with an adult.” 哪项忠实转述这句话？

items.material: Children must visit the cave with an adult.
items.before: Children must visit the cave with an
items.reason: adult表示成年人。a或an看开头的音，adult用an。须知中的must表示必须，with an adult说明需要成年人陪同；不能把这条要求弱化为可以独自去。具体陪同安排按活动规定确认。
items.hint: an adult；must表示必须，不能读成可选。

options.text: An adult is optional, so children may visit alone.
options.reason: 把must的必须改成了可有可无；原句不支持孩子单独参观。

options.text: Children need to be accompanied by an adult; use an adult, not a adult.
options.reason: must表示必须有成年人陪同；adult以元音音素开头，这里用an。

options.text: The notice requires a adult because adult begins with a consonant sound.
options.reason: adult以元音音素开头，不是辅音音素；应写an adult。

items.label: relative：亲属关系不能用“关系很好”替代
items.prompt: 记录：Mei是Lin的姨妈；Nora只被介绍为Lin的好朋友。哪项没有补出未知亲属关系？

items.material: We stayed with a relative during the holiday.
items.reason: relative是亲属，不是所有熟人或朋友的统称。close relative是近亲，close friend是好朋友。记录只说Nora是朋友，就不能自行断定她一定是亲属或一定不是；要找明写的亲属关系。
items.hint: relative是亲属；close friend不等于close relative。

options.text: Every close friend is automatically a close relative.
options.reason: close friend是好朋友，close relative是近亲；关系好不等于有亲属关系。

options.text: Only parents can be relatives, so an aunt cannot be a relative.
options.reason: relative不限于父母，姨妈也属于亲属。

options.text: Mei is a relative; the record does not tell us whether Nora is related to Lin.
options.reason: 姨妈明确属于亲属；好朋友这个称呼本身不能证明有亲属关系，也不能证明一定没有。

items.label: husband：先找谁是谁的配偶
items.prompt: 记录明确写着：Chen是Li的丈夫，Li是Chen的妻子。哪句从Li的视角介绍Chen？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录明确写着：Chen是Li的丈夫，Li是Chen的妻子。哪句从Li的视角介绍Chen？

items.material: Her husband is making tea in the kitchen.
items.after: is making tea in the kitchen.
items.reason: husband表示丈夫，wife表示妻子。本题身份由文字明确指定。Li介绍Chen，说my husband；Chen介绍Li，说my wife。先定说话人，再核对对方的关系，不能只看句里都有my就互换。
items.hint: husband是丈夫；从谁的视角介绍谁，要看记录。

options.text: Chen is my wife.
options.reason: 把记录里的丈夫误写成妻子；Li介绍Chen应说my husband。

options.text: Chen is my father.
options.reason: 记录给的是配偶关系，没有父女关系，不能把husband改成father。

options.text: Chen is my husband.
options.reason: 说话人是Li，记录中的Chen是她的丈夫，用my husband。

items.label: wife：复数wives，不是wifes或wife’s
items.prompt: 记录中三位男士各带着自己的妻子到场。要用复数说“他们的妻子”，哪项正确？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录中三位男士各带着自己的妻子到场。要用复数说“他们的妻子”，哪项正确？

items.material: His wife designed the little garden.
items.reason: wife的复数是不规则的wives，把fe改成ves。Their wives说多位妻子，his wife说一位。不要把名词复数和带撇号的所有格混在一起；读完数量和所属再决定词形。
items.hint: wife→wives；本句his wife说一位，填单数wife。

options.text: their wives
options.reason: wife的复数是wives：把fe改为ves。三位各一位，这里说复数。

options.text: their wifes
options.reason: wife不能直接加s写成wifes；正确复数是wives。

options.text: their wife’s
options.reason: wife’s是单数所有格或wife is等缩写，不能代替wives表示多位妻子。

items.label: couple：看后面有没有of，别把a couple of当成夫妻
items.prompt: 两句是“An elderly couple runs the bookshop.”和“I bought a couple of notebooks.” 哪项分清了两处用法？

wordDecision.prompt: 两句是“An elderly couple runs the bookshop.”和“I bought a couple of notebooks.” 哪项分清了两处用法？

items.material: An elderly couple runs the bookshop.
items.reason: couple可以指夫妻或一对人；a couple of后接复数名词，常表示两个或几个，具体看语境。不要把所有couple都译成夫妻。本句An elderly couple把这一对作为整体，谓语用runs。
items.hint: a couple指一对；a couple of +复数名词常指两个或几个。

options.text: 第一句说一对老年夫妻；第二句说买了两本或几本笔记本，不是在说夫妻。
options.reason: couple可指一对夫妻；a couple of也可表示两个或几个，需看后面接的名词和语境。

options.text: 两句couple都只能指夫妻，所以第二句意思是给夫妻买书。
options.reason: a couple of notebooks说笔记本的数量，不表示给夫妻买书。

options.text: a couple of notebooks表示不计其数，至少几百本。
options.reason: a couple of通常是两个或几个，不支持几百本这样的数量。

transfer.stem: Which note matches the visit record and uses the words correctly?
transfer.passage:
FAMILY READING VISIT
The club welcomes teenagers aged 13 to 19. Bo is 13 and Chen is 19. An is 12 and will join the children’s group. Three children are visiting the story room, and two adults will accompany them. In the quiet room, two babies are asleep. Each visitor should speak softly.

options.text: Bo and Chen can join the teenagers’ club, and the plural of baby is babies.
Chen is too old for the club because teenagers must be younger than 19.
Three childs are visiting without any adults.
There is only one baby because the plural form is babys.

answer.display: Bo and Chen can join the teenagers’ club, and the plural of baby is babies.

explanation.strategy: 先按写明的年龄判断组别，再按记录核对数量和不规则复数。

steps.text: Bo13岁、Chen19岁，都在活动明确写出的13—19岁范围内；An12岁进儿童组。
steps.reason: aged 13 to 19包含两个端点，不能擅自排除19岁。

steps.text: 三个孩子用three children；两个宝宝用two babies，且记录明确有两位成年人陪同。
steps.reason: children不是childs，babies不是babys；two adults will accompany them不能读成无人陪同。

distractors.reason: 19岁在本活动13—19岁的明确范围内，不能改成必须小于19岁。
child的复数是children，而且有两位成年人陪同，不是没有成年人。
two babies明确是两个，baby的复数是babies，不是babys。

explanation.pitfall: 范围的端点、记录里的数量和词的复数要分别核对；不要靠熟悉的字母直接加s。

visual.caption: 只按活动记录判组别和陪同人数；词形与原句一项项对照。
